name: boomurl Publishing API
description: Publish static websites and get an instant public URL. Auth is a bearer API key (boom_sk_...). Mint one via /api/v1/keys after email verification, then publish with a single idempotent PUT. Chat agents can instead use the hosted MCP server connector at https://boomurl.com/api/mcp (discovery: https://boomurl.com/.well-known/mcp.json).
